scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Sports And Adventure
other_conditions: Nominee must be a senior citizen who has won international acclaim in sports and continues to contribute in the field of sports and adventure
Nominee must have exemplary contribution and recognition at state, national or international level
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized nominating agency or individual; self‑nominations are not considered

Nominating agencies may include Government ministries, state governments, past award recipients, members of the National Council of Senior Citizens, recognized apex chambers of commerce, or any other persons/institutions authorized by the Ministry
The award is open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a cash prize of ₹2,50,000 together with a citation, memento and reimbursement of travel, lodging and DA/TA expenses.
